### Select a Pull Request Template

GitHub does not provide a UI dropdown for PR templates. Please switch to the **"Preview"** tab above and click the appropriate link to load your template:

* [Click here to load the **Feature Template**](?expand=1&PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE=feature.md)
* [Click here to load the **Chore / Infrastructure Template**](?expand=1&PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE=chore.md)
* [Click here to load the **Architectural Decision Follow-Up Template**](?=expand=1&PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE=adr.md)

---
*Note: Clicking a link will refresh the page and load the selected layout.*
